entries.title: Tell HN: Let's Be Civil
entries.author: raganwald
entries.excerpt: The release of the iPad Mini and the Microsoft surface have brought with them a rash of uncivil and inappropriate threads. I can count on one elbow the number of times I have seen the word "fanboy" or its faux-hipster alternate "fanboi" used in a comment that led to a productive discussion. entries.guide_zh: 用户呼吁讨论 iPad mini、Surface 等产品时保持礼貌。

entries.title: FBI Hack news on Hackernews is Fake

entries.guide_zh: 作者指出 HN 热门的 FBI 入侵消息是旧闻，质疑其被当作新事件传播。
